The BS1363 13A Fused Power Cord Cable is a dependable and safe 3-pin AC power supply adapter lead designed for daily use with laptops and electronic equipment.

Featuring a BS 1363-compliant fused plug (Type G) and a standard IEC C13 female connector, this cable ensures a stable, secure, and grounded power connection.


Key Features:


  • Plug Standard: BS 1363 (UK Type G)
  • Fuse Rating: 13 Amp built-in fuse
  • Connector Type: IEC C13 (Female)
  • Voltage: 250 V AC
  • Current: 13 A
  • Cable Length:  3 M
  • Certification: BS 1363 / IEC 60320 Standards


Benefits:


  • Built-in 13A fuse protects devices from overloads and power surges
  • Fully grounded 3-pin plug for safety and stability
  • Strong molded connectors resist wear and bending
  • Suitable for home, office, and IT environments
